segments.thag10.7:2.1: “Mittaṃ idha ca kalyāṇaṃ, sikkhā vipulaṃ samādānaṃ;
segments.thag10.7:2.3: Sussūsā ca garūnaṃ, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thag10.7:3.3: Saṅghe ca cittikāro, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thag10.7:4.3: Cittassa ca saṇṭhapanaṃ, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thag10.7:5.3: Adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thag10.7:8.3: Lokamhi ca anabhiratiṃ, etaṃ samaṇassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thag10.7:11.1: Kāḷudāyī ca so thero, ekavihārī ca kappino;
segments.thag10.7:11.3: Cūḷapanthako kappo ca, upaseno ca gotamo;
segments.thag10.7:11.5: Sattime dasake therā, gāthāyo cettha sattatīti.
